SUMMARY: I found no reproduced blocking failure in criteria 1–11. The `?genre=POETRY` case passes: the code lowercases the query, so it matches poetry and does not fall back to All. The only reproduced issues are minor: inline text links measure 20px tall, and the catalogue needs JavaScript. Probe-script mistakes on my side (timezone offset, `fill` respecting `maxlength`) were corrected and are not findings.
